name: FedEx Freight
fiscalYearEnd: May 31 for FY2026 (first 10-K); fiscal year end changed to December 31 effective June 1, 2026
description: FedEx Freight is the largest less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier in North America, spun off from FedEx on June 1, 2026 through a tax-free distribution. LTL carriers collect small freight shipments from many customers, consolidate them at service centers and move them in linked routes; customers pay per shipment based on weight, distance and class, plus fuel surcharge. It runs over 26,000 service-center doors and covers 98% of U.S. ZIP codes with about 108,000 active customers (top five customers only 9% of revenue). FY2026 revenue was $8.8B with a 6.1% operating margin, down from 15.8% because of $492M of spin-off costs and lower volume.

hq.note: 8285 Tournament Drive, Memphis, TN (10-K cover); administrative offices in Harrison, Arkansas

employees.note: approximately; over 365 locations; nearly 30,000 motorized vehicles

businessLines.name: Less-than-truckload (LTL) freight, priority and economy services
businessLines.how: Per-shipment charge by weight and lane (composite $386.63 per shipment, $41.54 per hundredweight in FY2026) plus fuel surcharge; volume follows industrial and consumer freight demand.
businessLines.description: Priority (time-critical) and economy LTL services across the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
